display_name: 兔子镜小剧场 / Rabbit Mirror Theater（TEST・生成方式切换・维修兔 v1.75-test）
author: Toto
description: RabbitMirror test build with mutually exclusive generation modes: follow the current API (inline or external presentation), or use a separately configured OpenAI-compatible API/model that receives the current chat text, available reasoning, character card, Persona, world-book/author-note context and produces one message-level external RabbitMirror. Independent mode removes RabbitMirror prompt injection from the current API. Includes safe auto-patrol test; no fixed prompt is added when independent mode is selected for the current API.
